purpose: Hardware provenance for generic Apple IOKit USB drivers; these files are not compiled or treated as a live firmware handoff.

controller.minimum_active_CX_scope: USB30 master at60MHz requires64; takeover must additionally cover the actual inherited root rate. This is not a complete AP baseline or measured firmware floor.

qusb2.generic_profile_wire_order: little-endian offset/value uint32 pairs, maximum 16 entries

connector.VCONN_hardware_selection: SMB2 0x1368 bit4 software control, bit3 enable, bit6 selects inactive CC (Normal=1, Reverse=0)

dma.required_production_handoff: Explicit verified handoff, Native exclusive-active-context capture, actual S2CR.TYPE=BYPASS capture, or exact exclusive disabled-stage1/S2-bypass capture under real leases/reset proof. Board resource policy and unused/shared-context ownership remain incomplete. No address window follows from a Linux DMA mask or absent iommus.
dma.production_context_handoff_property: qcom,usb-smmu-handoff: 128-byte version1; exact inherited context/ASID, observed guest CBAR only, no other visible active bank, stopped USB and retained fabric proof; does not grant physical namespace ownership
dma.existing_context_capture_request: qcom,usb-smmu-capture=<1>; QcomUSB1.5 checks matching software/hardware stop, installed IORT, actual NoC/GCC leases and BCR before capturing the128-byte record.
dma.bypass_capture_request: qcom,usb-dma-capture=<1> exact architected BYPASS64-byte v1; <2> exact exclusive disabled-stage1/S2-bypass80-byte v2; <3> complete no-match and actual USFCFG0,64-byte v3. All retain stop/fabric/reset proof and recheck the observed route.
dma.disabled_context_bypass_scope: Inherit exact exclusive existing bank only; no write probe, global change, bank allocation, root/ASID/VMID access, or shared-bank takeover.
dma.Native_resource_ACK_sequence_version: QcomRPM1.7.0; explicit nonzero rail/domain/clock/NoC ACKs then scaling; QcomUSB1.5 retains pre-GCC preparation and adds edge/level IRQ plus retained PM binding
dma.complete_board_resource_policy_producer_: Source frontend and Native preparation are integrated; complete production AP/board baseline data is still absent.

ANOC1_context_interrupt_reference.runtime_authority: Actual installed and checksummed IORT context IRQ numbers/flags matched to Apple GIC specifiers and provider getInterruptType
ANOC1_context_interrupt_reference.repository_IORT_candidate: Eight context entries, level flags; never overwrite the installed table based on this DTS reference
ANOC1_context_interrupt_reference.driver_support: QcomUSB1.5 supports exact edge or level, rejects selected IRQ shared with another bank or DWC3 core

Native_IORT_context_IRQ_binding.status: Source integrated and current unified offline validation passed; no Native or hardware execution
Native_IORT_context_IRQ_binding.runtime_authority: Actual installed checksummed IORT, Apple GIC specifiers and provider getInterruptType
Native_IORT_context_IRQ_binding.IORT_flags: bit0 edge1/level0; Apple GIC trigger edge0/level1
Native_IORT_context_IRQ_binding.retained_PM_binding: Validate original IRQ number, trigger and event-source index before enabling source or attaching root; no silent adoption

SMMU_guest_namespace_guard.policy: Preserve the observed inherited 8-bit guest CBAR.VMID and effective ASID; these do not prove physical TLB namespace ownership under HYP. Reject all other visible active banks and unknown SCTLR reads; latch runtime proof loss until actual root retirement and rebuild. No unused/shared-bank or namespace allocation is granted.

downstream_kernel_namespace_reference.observed_model: Read existing valid SMRs/S2CRs; reserve their indices and translated context banks in SMMU-wide bitmaps. Reuse exact static SID routes; otherwise allocate from the globally managed bitmap.
downstream_kernel_namespace_reference.namespace_model: Ordinary contexts use cbndx+1 ASID and cbndx+2 guest VMID; dynamic ASIDs use a SMMU-wide cyclic ID allocator.
downstream_kernel_namespace_reference.porting_boundary: These formulas require the owning SMMU manager and do not grant USB a vacant bank, an ASID/physical VMID namespace, or another client's shared bank under firmware HYP.

resource_policy_handoff.status: USB inherited/target clock coverage and shared AP baseline preflight source-integrated and offline-validated; production handoff remains incomplete
resource_policy_handoff.pre_GCC_protocol: Protocol2 RPM, consumer9, PrepareUSBResources id=max(inherited core Hz,target core Hz), value/flags0; wire layout and vtables unchanged.
resource_policy_handoff.pre_GCC_sequence: Pinned topology/stop -> actual BCR18 -> inherited GCC root163 rate -> RPM Domains/ResourceHandoff capabilities -> PrepareUSBResources id=covered Hz -> shared preflight and complete AP baseline ACKs/channel check -> ACKed CX level -> unchanged root rate -> BCR18 -> GCC mutations.
resource_policy_handoff.unknown_ACK_ownership: RPM retains applied or uncertain AP floors; no GCC reference is acquired when preparation fails
resource_policy_handoff.synthetic_profiles_scope: Temporary host-model fixtures only; no bootable synthetic-profile EFI produced
remaining: Complete authoritative AP baseline and board policy data for the integrated unified producer; submitted NPA requests and synthetic test profiles do not establish safe production floors.
Complete authoritative unused-context/namespace allocation or shared-bank ownership when no supported exclusive inherited active, architected BYPASS or disabled-stage1/S2-bypass route exists.
Enable production board USB matching nodes only after complete source handoff exists; Native kernel and hardware execution follow source completion.
